candidates.change_summary: Change final return value from true to false so successful (non-reverting) calls return false instead of true.
Return the success flag of the last external call (so return value reflects call result rather than always true).

Insert an early unconditional return true immediately after the require, causing function to return true without performing any calls (observable difference when original would do work but still return true — still different behavior for side-effects, but returns remain true; however this mutant changes when calls are executed and thus may return different values if later modified — INCLUDED because it changes observable external behavior by skipping calls).
Change the called selector to target transfer(address,address,uint256) (remove From) so external contract receives different parameters and fallback behavior may differ.
Call using call with only two arguments (to address and value) instead of three, altering calldata and likely failing or invoking a different function on target.
Remove the revert on failed external call and instead ignore failures, changing observable result when target call fails.
Swap the order of parameters passed to the external call (send _tos[i] before from), altering called function behavior or causing mismatch.
